rows.source_ko: 방위사업청 (조직인사담당관), 02-2079-6043
rows.text_en: Defense Acquisition Program Administration ( Organization and Personnel Officer ), 02-2079-6043

rows.source_ko: 제1장 총칙
rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 방위사업청과 그 소속기관에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직급별 정원, 「정부조직법」 제2조제3항 및 제5항에 따라 국장 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「방위사업청과 그 소속기관 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organization of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing levels for auxiliary and advisory agencies established within the Defense Acquisition Program Administration and its affiliated agencies, the establishment of auxiliary agencies placed under a director pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the “Government Organization Act” and advisory agencies equivalent thereto, and the division of duties.

rows.source_ko: 제2장 방위사업청
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Defense Acquisition Program Administration

rows.source_ko: 제2조(차장) 차장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Deputy Minister) The Deputy Minister shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Dec. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(대변인) 대변인은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Spokesperson) The Spokesperson shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretaries, Secretaries, or field-grade officers. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>
Article 3-2 Deleted <2018. 11. 27.>

rows.source_ko: 제3조의3(방위사업감독관) ① 방위사업감독관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3-3 (Defense Acquisition Supervisor) ① The Defense Acquisition Supervisor shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 방위사업감독관 밑에 감독총괄담당관ㆍ감독지원담당관 및 사업검증담당관을 두되, 감독총괄담당관 및 감독지원담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 사업검증담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 감사관으로 보한다. <개정 2016. 2. 24., 2018. 11. 27., 2019. 9. 17., 2023. 8. 30., 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② Under the Defense Acquisition Program Supervisor, a Director General of Supervision, a Director General of Supervision Support, and a Director General of Project Verification shall be established; provided that the Director General of Supervision and the Director General of Supervision Support shall be appointed as Deputy Director Generals, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary, and the Director General of Project Verification shall be appointed as Deputy Director Generals, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Auditors. <Amended Feb. 24, 2016; Nov. 27, 2018; Sep. 17, 2019; Aug. 30, 2023; Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 감독총괄담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 방위사업감독관을 보좌한다. <개정 2018. 11. 27.>

rows.text_en: 1. Policy Formulation and Institutional Improvement Regarding Verification and Investigation of Defense Projects

rows.source_ko: 제9조(방위산업진흥국) ① 방위산업진흥국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 또는 장성급 장교로 보하되, 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Defense Industry Promotion Bureau) ① The Director of the Defense Industry Promotion Bureau shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service or general officers; provided, however, that in the case of appointment as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 방위산업진흥국에 방산정책과ㆍ방산중소기업지원과ㆍ방산자원전략과ㆍ방위산업협력과ㆍ인증기획과 및 원가관리과를 두되, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로 보한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Defense Industry Promotion Bureau shall have the Defense Industry Policy Division, Defense SME Support Division, Defense Resource Strategy Division, Defense Industry Cooperation Division, Certification Planning Division, and Cost Management Division; the heads of each division shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretaries, Secretaries, or field-grade officers. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Defense Industry Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 방위산업발전 기본계획ㆍ시행계획의 수립 및 시행

rows.source_ko: 9. 방위산업 관련 단체ㆍ협회 및 전문연구기관에 대한 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 9. Guidance and supervision of defense industry-related organizations, associations, and specialized research institutions

rows.source_ko: 10. 공제조합의 설립ㆍ운영 및 감독 등에 관한 업무

rows.source_ko: 11. 그 밖에 국 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other domestic divisions

rows.text_en: 12. Management duties regarding military technical support by the Defense Technology Quality Agency for mass-produced goods

rows.text_en: Article 10 (Defense Technology Development and Protection Bureau) ① The Director of the Defense Technology Development and Protection Bureau shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2020; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제11조(기반전력사업본부) ① 기반전력사업본부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 또는 장성급 장교로 보하되, 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2012. 7. 18., 2017. 10. 18., 2019. 9. 17.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Base Power Business Division) ① The Head of the Base Power Business Division shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service or general officers; provided, however, that in the case of appointment as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Jul. 18, 2012; Oct. 18, 2017; Sep. 17, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ② 기반전력사업지원부장ㆍ기동사업부장ㆍ화력사업부장ㆍ함정사업부장ㆍ항공기사업부장 및 헬기사업부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 또는 장성급 장교로 보하되, 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2012. 7. 18., 2016. 3. 22., 2017. 10. 18., 2019. 9. 17., 2020. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The Directors of the Base Power Project Support Department, Mobility Project Department, Thermal Power Project Department, Naval Vessel Project Department, Aircraft Project Department, and Helicopter Project Department shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service or general officers; provided, however, that if appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of such position shall be Grade B. <Amended July 18, 2012; March 22, 2016; October 18, 2017; September 17, 2019; December 31, 2020>
[Title amended Sep. 17, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(기반전력사업지원부의 하부조직) ① 기반전력사업지원부에 기반전력사업총괄팀ㆍ지상공통전력운영계약팀ㆍ해상공중전력운영계약팀ㆍ기반전력사업전력화지원관리팀ㆍ기반전력사업표준자원관리팀ㆍ기반전력사업지상공통원가팀 및 기반전력사업해상공중원가팀을 둔다. <개정 2021. 7. 23., 2023. 7. 14., 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 12. 31., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Subordinate Organizations of the Infrastructure Power Business Support Department) ① The Infrastructure Power Business Support Department shall be established with the Infrastructure Power Business General Management Team, the Ground Common Power Operation Contract Team, the Offshore/Air Power Operation Contract Team, the Infrastructure Power Business Electrification Support Management Team, the Infrastructure Power Business Standard Resource Management Team, the Infrastructure Power Business Ground Common Cost Team, and the Infrastructure Power Business Offshore/Air Cost Team. <Amended Jul. 23, 2021; Jul. 14, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 기반전력사업총괄팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로, 지상공통전력운영계약팀장 및 기반전력사업지상공통원가팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로, 해상공중전력운영계약팀장ㆍ기반전력사업표준자원관리팀장 및 기반전력사업해상공중원가팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로, 기반전력사업전력화지원관리팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 12., 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 12. 31., 2025. 12. 30.>

rows.source_ko: 4. 기반전력사업본부 내 방위력개선사업의 관리와 관련된 법령 및 훈령ㆍ예규 등의 제ㆍ개정과 제도 발전에 관한 업무

rows.source_ko: 5. 기반전력사업본부 소관 업무에 관한 국회 및 감사 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 5. Matters related to the National Assembly and audits concerning the affairs under the jurisdiction of the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 6. 기반전력사업본부 내 인사ㆍ교육에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Personnel and training matters within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 7. 기반전력사업본부 내 경상비 예산 운영 및 보급 관리 업무
rows.text_en: 7. Operation of operating budget and supply management within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 8. 기반전력사업본부 내 보안에 관한 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 8. Overall management of security matters within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 9. 기반전력사업본부 내 행정관리에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 9. Duties regarding administrative management within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 10. 기반전력사업본부 내 성과관리 및 홍보에 관한 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 10. Overall management of performance management and public relations within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 11. 기반전력사업본부 내 조달사업 집행 지시 및 예산 관리
rows.text_en: 11. Instructions for Procurement Project Execution and Budget Management within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 12. 기반전력사업본부 내 사업집행실적 분석ㆍ점검
rows.text_en: 12. Analysis and Review of Project Execution Performance within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 13. 기반전력사업본부 내 관인 및 문서 관리에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 13. Duties regarding official seal and document management within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 14. 기반전력사업본부 내 지출심사분야의 계획 수립 및 심사ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 14. Planning, Review, and Evaluation of Expenditure Review Fields within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 15. 기반전력사업본부 내 재무관 및 계약관 직인 관리
rows.text_en: 15. Management of official seals for the Finance Officer and Contract Officer within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 16. 기반전력사업본부 내 대금(선금ㆍ착수금 및 중도금을 포함한다) 청구서류의 접수ㆍ심사 및 지급의뢰
rows.text_en: 16. Receipt, examination, and payment request for invoices (including advance payments, down payments, and interim payments) within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 17. 기반전력사업본부 내 채권양도 승인 및 납품실적 증명에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 17. Tasks regarding approval of assignment of receivables and certification of delivery performance within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 18. 기반전력사업본부 내 월별 대금지출 소요의 종합
rows.text_en: 18. Summary of Monthly Payment Requirements within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 19. 그 밖에 기반전력사업본부 내 다른 팀의 소관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 19. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other teams within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: ④ 지상공통전력운영계약팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Ground Common Power Operation Contract Team shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 지상 및 공통 전력 관련 「방위사업청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제12조제2호 및 제3호의 조달 품목(이하 이 조에서 “지상공통 국내 조달 품목”이라 한다)에 대한 조달집행계획의 수립 및 집행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and execution of procurement execution plans for procurement items related to ground and common forces under Article 12 , Subparagraphs 2 and 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies” (hereinafter referred to as “ground common domestic procurement items” in this Article).

rows.source_ko: 2. 지상공통 국내 조달 품목에 대한 조달 판단, 공고, 원가산정 의뢰, 입찰 및 계약 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Procurement decision-making, announcement, cost estimation request, bidding, and contracting tasks for domestic procurement items common to ground operations

rows.source_ko: 3. 지상공통 국내 조달 품목에 대한 수의계약 가격의 협상
rows.text_en: 3. Negotiation of direct contract prices for common domestic procurement items

rows.source_ko: 4. 지상공통 국내 조달 품목에 대한 입찰 적격심사 대상품목의 선정 검토 및 심사
rows.text_en: 4. Review and Evaluation of Selection of Items Subject to Bid Qualification Review for Common Domestic Procurement Items

rows.source_ko: 5. 지상공통 국내 조달 품목 계약품목에 대한 하도급 승인
rows.text_en: 5. Approval of subcontracting for contract items of domestic procurement common to ground operations

rows.source_ko: 6. 지상공통 국내 조달 품목의 신규 또는 국산대체 품목에 대한 구매가능 판단자료의 제공
rows.text_en: 6. Provision of data for determining the feasibility of purchasing new or domestic substitute items for common domestic procurement items

rows.source_ko: 7. 지상공통 국내 조달 품목에 관한 계약해지 및 부정당업자의 제재 건의
rows.text_en: 7. Recommendation for Contract Termination and Sanctions on Dishonest Contractors Regarding Common Domestic Procurement Items

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 해상공중전력운영계약팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Maritime and Air Force Operation Contracting Team shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해상 및 공중 전력 관련 「방위사업청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제12조제2호 및 제3호의 조달 품목(이하 이 조에서 “해상공중 국내 조달 품목”이라 한다)에 대한 조달집행계획의 수립 및 집행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and execution of procurement execution plans for procurement items related to maritime and air power pursuant to Article 12, Subparagraphs 2 and 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies” (hereinafter referred to as “maritime and air domestic procurement items” in this Article).

rows.source_ko: 2. 해상공중 국내 조달 품목에 대한 조달 판단, 공고, 원가산정 의뢰, 입찰 및 계약 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Procurement decision-making, announcement, request for cost estimation, bidding, and contracting affairs for domestic procurement items in the maritime and aerial sectors

rows.source_ko: 3. 해상공중 국내 조달 품목에 대한 수의계약 가격의 협상
rows.text_en: 3. Negotiation of direct contract prices for domestically procured maritime and aerial items

rows.source_ko: 4. 해상공중 국내 조달 품목에 대한 입찰 적격심사 대상품목의 선정 검토 및 심사
rows.text_en: 4. Review and Evaluation of Selection of Items Subject to Bid Qualification Assessment for Domestic Procurement of Maritime and Aircraft

rows.source_ko: 5. 해상공중 국내 조달 품목 계약품목에 대한 하도급 승인
rows.text_en: 5. Approval of subcontracting for contracted items of domestic procurement for maritime and aerial services

rows.source_ko: 6. 해상공중 국내 조달 품목의 신규 또는 국산대체 품목에 대한 구매가능 판단자료의 제공
rows.text_en: 6. Provision of data for determining the feasibility of purchasing new or domestic substitute items for maritime and air domestic procurement items

rows.source_ko: 7. 해상공중 국내 조달 품목에 관한 계약해지 및 부정당업자의 제재 건의
rows.text_en: 7. Recommendation for contract termination and sanctions against dishonest contractors regarding domestic procurement of maritime and aerial items

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 기반전력사업전력화지원관리팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 7. 23., 2022. 12. 20.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Team Leader of the Infrastructure Power Business Electrification Support Management Team shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jul. 23, 2021; Dec. 20, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 기반전력사업본부 내 각 사업부의 통합체계지원(IPS, Integrated Product Support) 업무 기술지원 및 업무체계의 발전
rows.text_en: 1. Development of technical support and work systems for Integrated Product Support (IPS) operations in each business unit within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 2. 기반전력사업본부 내 통합체계지원에 대한 분석결과 검토 및 환류
rows.text_en: 2. Review and feedback of analysis results regarding integrated system support within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 3. 기반전력사업본부 내 통합체계지원 분석시스템의 운영 및 자료 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Operation and Data Management of the Integrated System Support Analysis System within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 5. 기반전력사업 관련 전력화 이후 현존전력 성능 극대화 사업, 획득ㆍ운영유지 연계사업 등 전력화 지원 업무
rows.text_en: 5. Electrification support tasks related to infrastructure power projects, such as projects to maximize the performance of existing power after electrification and acquisition, operation, and maintenance linkage projects.

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 기반전력사업표준자원관리팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 7. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Team Leader of the Standard Resource Management Team for Infrastructure Power Business shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended July 23, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 기반전력사업본부 내 규격화 관련 계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of standardization-related plans within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 2. 기반전력사업본부 내 군수품 규격화 및 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Standardization and Management of Military Supplies within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 3. 기반전력사업본부 내 각 사업팀에서 사업 종료 후 형상자료를 인계한 운영단계 무기체계의 형상 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Configuration management of weapon systems in the operational phase to which configuration data was handed over by each project team within the Base Power Business Division after project completion

rows.source_ko: 4. 기반전력사업본부 내 국외조달 요구 품목에 대한 국산화 개발 품목의 확인
rows.text_en: 4. Verification of domestically developed items for foreign procurement requirements within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 5. 기반전력사업본부 내 전력지원체계의 형상 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Configuration management of the power support system within the Infrastructure Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 6. 기반전력사업본부 내 각 사업팀 등 다른 부서 소관 규격화 기술지원 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Standardization technical support tasks for other departments, such as each business team within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 7. 기반전력사업본부 내 국방규격의 관리ㆍ보급에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 7. Duties regarding the management and distribution of defense standards within the Base Power Business Headquarters

rows.source_ko: 8. 기반전력사업본부 내 군수품 목록화 및 관리 업무
rows.text_en: 8. Inventorying and management of military supplies within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 9. 기반전력사업본부 내 각 사업팀의 사업수행에 요구되는 목록화 업무에 대한 검토 및 기술지원
rows.text_en: 9. Review and technical support for cataloging tasks required for project execution by each business team within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 10. 기반전력사업본부 내 조달관리 업무 수행 시 필요한 목록자료의 지원
rows.text_en: 10. Support for catalog data required for performing procurement management tasks within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 11. 기반전력사업본부 내 군수품의 목록화 관련 업무 지원
rows.text_en: 11. Support for tasks related to the cataloging of military supplies within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 12. 기반전력사업본부 내 외국과의 군수품목록정보 교류 실시
rows.text_en: 12. Implementation of exchange of military supply catalog information with foreign countries within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 13. 기반전력사업본부 내 목록화 요청서 접수 및 배부
rows.text_en: 13. Receipt and distribution of cataloging requests within the Base Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 기반전력사업지상공통원가팀장은 기동사업부ㆍ화력사업부 소관 분야의 방위력개선사업 및 지상공통 국내 조달 품목에 관하여 다음 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Team Leader of the Ground Common Cost Team for Infrastructure Power Projects shall be responsible for the following matters regarding defense capability improvement projects and ground common domestic procurement items in the fields under the jurisdiction of the Mobility Projects Division and the Thermal Power Projects Division. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 원가분석 계획의 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and Implementation of Cost Analysis Plan

rows.source_ko: 2. 원가계산서의 접수 및 분석
rows.text_en: 2. Receipt and Analysis of Cost Statements

rows.source_ko: 3. 원가검증 대상 사업에 대한 검증 의뢰
rows.text_en: 3. Request for verification of projects subject to cost verification

rows.source_ko: 4. 원가의 분석 및 예정가격 기초자료의 작성
rows.text_en: 4. Cost Analysis and Preparation of Basic Data for Estimated Prices

rows.source_ko: 5. 원가 심사 의뢰 및 확정
rows.text_en: 5. Request for Cost Review and Finalization

rows.source_ko: 6. 가격조사 계획의 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and Implementation of Price Survey Plan

rows.source_ko: 7. 가격조사 품목에 대한 가격조사서의 작성
rows.text_en: 7. Preparation of Price Survey Forms for Price Survey Items

rows.source_ko: 8. 원가에 관한 통계 기록의 유지 및 자료의 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Maintenance of statistical records regarding costs and management of data

rows.source_ko: 9. 상업구매에 관한 목표가 산정 및 수입가격 검증
rows.text_en: 9. Calculation of Target Prices and Verification of Import Prices for Commercial Purchases

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 기반전력사업해상공중원가팀장은 함정사업부ㆍ항공기사업부 및 헬기사업부 소관 분야의 방위력개선사업 및 해상공중 국내 조달 품목에 관하여 제8항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2020. 12. 31., 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Maritime and Air Cost Team for Base Force Projects shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Paragraph 8 regarding defense capability improvement projects and domestic procurement items for maritime and air in the fields under the jurisdiction of the Ship Business Division, Aircraft Business Division, and Helicopter Business Division. <Amended Dec. 31, 2020; Mar. 26, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024>
[Wholly revised Sep. 17, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제13조(기동사업부의 하부조직) ① 기동사업부에 기동총괄계약팀ㆍ전차사업팀ㆍ장갑차사업팀ㆍ전투차량사업팀 및 전투장비사업팀을 두되, 기동총괄계약팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로, 장갑차사업팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로, 전차사업팀장ㆍ전투차량사업팀장 및 전투장비사업팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로 보한다. <개정 2019. 12. 31., 2021. 7. 23., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Subordinate Organizations of the Mobility Business Division) ① The Mobility Business Division shall have the Mobility General Contracting Team, Tank Project Team, Armored Vehicle Project Team, Combat Vehicle Project Team, and Combat Equipment Project Team; provided that the Head of the Mobility General Contracting Team shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or Field-grade officer; the Head of the Armored Vehicle Project Team shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or Field-grade officer; and the Heads of the Tank Project Team, Combat Vehicle Project Team, and Combat Equipment Project Team shall be appointed as Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or Field-grade officer. <Amended Dec. 31, 2019; July 23, 2021; August 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 기동총괄계약팀장은 기동 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 다음 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 7. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Mobility General Contracting Team shall be responsible for the following matters regarding defense capability improvement projects in the mobility sector. <Amended July 23, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 조달집행계획의 수립 및 집행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and Execution of Procurement Execution Plan

rows.source_ko: 2. 조달 판단, 공고, 원가산정 의뢰, 입찰 및 계약 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Procurement judgment, public notice, cost estimation request, bidding and contracting affairs

rows.source_ko: 3. 수의계약 가격의 협상
rows.text_en: 3. Negotiation of Private Contract Price

rows.source_ko: 4. 입찰 적격심사 대상품목의 선정 검토 및 심사
rows.text_en: 4. Review and Evaluation of Selection of Items Subject to Bid Qualification Review

rows.source_ko: 5. 계약품목에 대한 하도급 승인
rows.text_en: 5. Approval of subcontracting for contract items

rows.source_ko: 6. 신규 또는 국산대체 품목에 대한 구매가능 판단자료의 제공
rows.text_en: 6. Provision of data for determining the feasibility of purchasing new or domestic substitute items

rows.source_ko: 7. 부내 사업ㆍ계약 이행관리, 수출지원, 절충교역 지원 등 총괄업무
rows.text_en: 7. Overall management of internal projects and contract execution, export support, offset trade support, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7의2. 계약해지 및 부정당업자의 제재 건의
rows.text_en: 7-2. Recommendation for Contract Termination and Sanctions against Unfair Contractors

rows.source_ko: 8. 국제계약 관련 계획의 수립 및 국제계약 체결에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment of plans related to international contracts and duties concerning the conclusion of international contracts

rows.source_ko: 9. 국제계약에 따른 신용장 개설 및 계약이행보증금 설정에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the opening of letters of credit and the establishment of performance guarantees under international contracts

rows.source_ko: 10. 국제계약에 따른 대금 지불 및 사후 관리에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning payment and follow-up management under international contracts

rows.source_ko: 11. 그 밖에 부내 다른 팀의 소관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other teams within the department

rows.source_ko: ③ 전차사업팀장은 전차 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 다음 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2020. 12. 31., 2021. 7. 23., 2023. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Tank Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the following matters regarding defense capability improvement projects in the tank sector. <Amended Dec. 31, 2020; Jul. 23, 2021; Dec. 12, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 사업별 선행연구 요구서 작성 및 사업추진 기본전략의 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Preparation of requests for preliminary research by project and establishment of basic strategies for project implementation

rows.source_ko: 2. 사업별 중기계획ㆍ예산안의 작성 및 예산집행실적의 분석ㆍ결산
rows.text_en: 2. Preparation of medium-term plans and budget proposals by project, and analysis and settlement of budget execution performance

rows.source_ko: 3. 구매사업에 대한 협상팀 구성 및 협상계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 3. Formation of a negotiation team and establishment of a negotiation plan for the purchasing project

rows.source_ko: 4. 사업별 기종결정 및 사업계획변경의 건의
rows.text_en: 4. Proposal for Aircraft Model Selection and Project Plan Changes by Project

rows.source_ko: 5. 연구개발사업의 협상우선순위ㆍ업체선정안 및 탐색ㆍ체계개발 실행계획서 작성ㆍ건의
rows.text_en: 5. Preparation and proposal of negotiation priorities, vendor selection plans, and exploration and system development implementation plans for R&D projects

rows.source_ko: 6. 전력화 평가결과의 검토
rows.text_en: 6. Review of Electrification Evaluation Results

rows.source_ko: 7. 해당 사업 관련 홍보 및 대외 협력 업무와 관련 회의체 등의 운영에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 7. Duties regarding publicity and external cooperation related to the project, and the operation of related meetings, etc.

rows.source_ko: 8. 「방위사업법」 제12조제2항에 따라 방위사업청장이 정한 통합사업관리제에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 8. Duties regarding the Integrated Project Management System determined by the Administrator of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Defense Acquisition Program Act

rows.source_ko: 9. 무기체계의 개발ㆍ생산 및 운영유지에 관한 사업의 목표치로 설정한 비용의 검토ㆍ분석 및 통제ㆍ검증
rows.text_en: 9. Review, analysis, control, and verification of costs set as target values ​​for projects related to the development, production, and operation and maintenance of weapon systems

rows.source_ko: 10. 방위력개선사업의 추진단계별 비용ㆍ일정ㆍ성과관리의 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 10. Coordination and control of cost, schedule, and performance management by implementation phase of defense capability improvement projects

rows.source_ko: 11. 방위사업 관련 물품과 국유재산에 대한 관리
rows.text_en: 11. Management of defense-related goods and state-owned property

rows.source_ko: 12. 무기체계별 방산물자등의 수출지원과 방위력개선사업의 추진단계별 수출 관련 검토 및 협력 업무
rows.text_en: 12. Export support for defense materials, etc. by weapon system, and review and cooperation regarding exports at each stage of defense capability improvement projects

rows.source_ko: ④ 장갑차사업팀장은 장갑차 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Armored Vehicle Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the matters of each subparagraph of Paragraph 3 regarding defense capability improvement projects in the armored vehicle sector.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 전투차량사업팀장은 전투차량 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Combat Vehicle Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the matters of each subparagraph of Paragraph 3 regarding defense capability improvement projects in the combat vehicle sector.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 전투장비사업팀장은 전투장비 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Combat Equipment Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the matters of each subparagraph of Paragraph 3 regarding defense capability improvement projects in the combat equipment sector.
[Wholly revised Sep. 17, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제13조의2(화력사업부의 하부조직) ① 화력사업부에 화력총괄계약팀ㆍ포병사업팀ㆍ대화력사업팀ㆍ탄약사업팀 및 화생방사업팀을 두며, 화력총괄계약팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로, 대화력사업팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로, 포병사업팀장ㆍ탄약사업팀장 및 화생방사업팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로 보한다. <개정 2019. 12. 31., 2021. 7. 23., 2022. 12. 20., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 13-2 (Subordinate Organizations of the Firepower Business Division) ① The Firepower Business Division shall have the Firepower General Contract Team, Artillery Business Team, Counter-Firepower Business Team, Ammunition Business Team, and CBRN Business Team. The Head of the Firepower General Contract Team shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or Field-grade officer; the Head of the Counter-Firepower Business Team shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or Field-grade officer; and the Heads of the Artillery Business Team, Ammunition Business Team, and CBRN Business Team shall be appointed as Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or Field-grade officers. <Amended Dec. 31, 2019; July 23, 2021; Dec. 20, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 화력총괄계약팀장은 화력ㆍ화생방 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제2항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 7. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Firepower General Contracting Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 2, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the fields of firepower and chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN ). <Amended July 23, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ③ 포병사업팀장은 포병 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Artillery Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the artillery sector .

rows.source_ko: ④ 대화력사업팀장은 대(對) 화력 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Large Firepower Project Team shall be responsible for the matters of each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3 regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of firepower .

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 탄약사업팀장은 탄약 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Ammunition Business Team Leader shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3 regarding defense capability improvement projects in the ammunition sector .

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 화생방사업팀장은 화생방 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2021. 7. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the CBRN Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the CBRN field . <Newly added July 23, 2021>
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 17, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제13조의3(함정사업부의 하부조직) ① 함정사업부에 함정총괄계약팀ㆍ호위함사업팀ㆍ한국형구축함사업팀ㆍ상륙함사업팀ㆍ고속기뢰전함사업팀ㆍ합동전력함정사업팀 및 한국형유무인전력모함사업팀을 둔다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 13-3 (Subordinate Organizations of the Ship Business Division) ① The Ship Business Division shall have the Ship General Contracting Team, Frigate Project Team, Korean Destroyer Project Team, Landing Ship Project Team, High-Speed ​​Mine Warfare Ship Project Team, Joint Force Ship Project Team, and Korean Manned/Unmanned Force Carrier Project Team. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 함정총괄계약팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로, 호위함사업팀장 및 상륙함사업팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로, 한국형구축함사업팀장ㆍ고속기뢰전함사업팀장 및 합동전력함정사업팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로, 한국형유무인전력모함사업팀장은 서기관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ통계사무관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ농업사무관ㆍ해양수산사무관ㆍ항공사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 영관급 장교로 보한다. <신설 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Vessel General Contracting Team shall be appointed as a Deputy Director General, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or a field-grade officer; the Heads of the Frigate Project Team and the Landing Ship Project Team shall be appointed as Deputy Director General, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or a field-grade officer; the Heads of the Korean Destroyer Project Team, the High-Speed ​​Mine Warfare Ship Project Team, and the Joint Force Vessel Project Team shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or a field-grade officer; and the Head of the Korean Manned/Unmanned Force Carrier Project Team shall be appointed as a Secretary, Science and Technology Secretary, Administrative Officer, Statistics Officer, Industrial Officer, Agriculture Officer, Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Officer, Aviation Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or a field-grade officer. <Newly Inserted Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 함정총괄계약팀장은 함정 분야(핵추진잠수함 및 한국형잠수함 관련 분야는 제외한다) 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제2항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2020. 12. 31., 2021. 7. 23., 2025. 12. 30., 2026. 8. 14.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Vessel General Contracting Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13 , Paragraph 2, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the vessel sector (excluding fields related to nuclear-powered submarines and Korean-type submarines). <Amended Dec. 31, 2020; Jul. 23, 2021; Dec. 30, 2025; Aug. 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ④ 호위함사업팀장은 호위함 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Frigate Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the frigate sector . <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 한국형구축함사업팀장은 한국형구축함 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2022. 2. 22., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Korean Destroyer Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of Korean destroyers . <Amended Feb. 22, 2022; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 상륙함사업팀장은 상륙함 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2020. 12. 31., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Landing Ship Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the landing ship sector . <Newly added Dec. 31, 2020; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 고속기뢰전함사업팀장은 고속함 및 기뢰전함 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2020. 12. 31., 2024. 3. 26., 2025. 2. 25., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the High-Speed ​​Mine Warfare Ship Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the fields of high-speed vessels and mine warfare ships . <Newly added Dec. 31, 2020; Mar. 26, 2024; Feb. 25, 2025; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 합동전력함정사업팀장은 합동전력함정 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2020. 12. 31., 2024. 3. 26., 2025. 2. 25., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Team Leader of the Joint Force Vessel Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13 , Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of joint force vessels . <Newly added Dec. 31, 2020; Mar. 26, 2024; Feb. 25, 2025; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 한국형유무인전력모함사업팀장은 한국형유무인전력모함 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Team Leader of the Korean Manned/Unmanned Force Carrier Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of the Korean Manned/Unmanned Force Carrier . <Newly added Dec. 30, 2025>

[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 17, 2019]
[Title Amended Dec. 31, 2020]
Article 13-4 Deleted <December 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 제13조의5(항공기사업부의 하부조직) ① 항공기사업부에 항공기총괄계약팀ㆍ전투기사업팀ㆍ공중기동기사업팀ㆍ국산항공기사업팀 및 해상항공기사업팀을 두되, 항공기총괄계약팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로, 전투기사업팀장 ㆍ공중기동기사업팀장 및 국산항공기사업팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로, 해상항공기사업팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로 보한다. <개정 2019. 12. 31., 2021. 7. 23., 2023. 4. 11., 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 13-5 (Subordinate Organizations of the Aircraft Business Division) ① The Aircraft Business Division shall have the Aircraft General Contracting Team, Fighter Aircraft Project Team, Air Mobility Aircraft Project Team, Domestic Aircraft Project Team, and Maritime Aircraft Project Team; provided that the Head of the Aircraft General Contracting Team shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or a Field-grade officer; the Heads of the Fighter Aircraft Project Team, Air Mobility Aircraft Project Team, and Domestic Aircraft Project Team shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or a Field-grade officer; and the Head of the Maritime Aircraft Project Team shall be appointed as a Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or a Field-grade officer. <Amended Dec. 31, 2019; July 23, 2021; Apr. 11, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 12, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 항공기총괄계약팀장은 항공기 분야(한국형전투기 개발 관련 분야는 제외한다) 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제2항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 7. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Aircraft General Contracting Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 2, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the aircraft sector (excluding fields related to the development of the Korean Fighter) . <Amended July 23, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ③ 전투기사업팀장은 전투기 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Fighter Jet Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the fighter jet sector .

rows.source_ko: ④ 공중기동기사업팀장은 공중기동기 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Air Mobility Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the matters of each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3 regarding defense capability improvement projects in the air mobility sector .

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 국산항공기사업팀장은 국산 항공기(개발완료된 고정익항공기로서 유인기에 한정한다) 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2023. 4. 11., 2023. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Domestic Aircraft Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3 , regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of domestic aircraft (limited to manned fixed-wing aircraft for which development has been completed) . <Amended Apr. 11, 2023; Dec. 12, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 해상항공기사업팀장은 해상항공기 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2023. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Maritime Aircraft Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the maritime aircraft sector . <Amended Dec. 12, 2023>
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 17, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제13조의6(헬기사업부의 하부조직) ① 헬기사업부에 헬기총괄계약팀 및 공격헬기사업팀을 두며, 헬기총괄계약팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로 보하고, 공격헬기사업팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로 보한다. <개정 2021. 7. 23., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 13-6 (Subordinate Organizations of the Helicopter Business Division) ① The Helicopter Business Division shall have a Helicopter General Contracting Team and an Attack Helicopter Project Team. The Head of the Helicopter General Contracting Team shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretaries, Secretaries, or field-grade officers, and the Head of the Attack Helicopter Project Team shall be appointed from among Science and Technology Secretaries, Secretaries, Senior Specialists, or field-grade officers. <Amended Jul. 23, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 헬기총괄계약팀장은 한국형헬기 개발 및 헬기 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제2항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 7. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Helicopter General Contracting Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 2, regarding the development of the Korean-type helicopter and defense capability improvement projects in the helicopter sector . <Amended July 23, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ③ 공격헬기사업팀장은 공격헬기 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2021. 7. 23.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Attack Helicopter Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the attack helicopter sector . <Newly added July 23, 2021>
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 17, 2019]
Article 14 Deleted <September 17, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 제15조(한시적인 보조기관의 설치) 「방위사업청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제14조제2항의 단서에 따른 한시적인 보조기관은 15개 팀의 범위(제22조에 따라 미래전력사업본부에 설치하는 한시적인 보조기관의 수를 포함한다)에서 방위사업청장이 정한다. <개정 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Establishment of Temporary Auxiliary Agencies) The Administrator of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration shall determine the temporary auxiliary agencies pursuant to the proviso of Article 14, Paragraph 2 of the “Organizational Structure of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies” within the scope of 15 teams ( including the number of temporary auxiliary agencies established in the Future Force Project Headquarters pursuant to Article 22 ) . <Amended Dec. 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 제4장 미래전력사업본부 <개정 2019. 9. 17.>
rows.text_en: Chapter 4 Future Power Business Division <Amended Sep. 17, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 제16조(미래전력사업본부) ① 미래전력사업본부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 또는 장성급 장교로 보하되, 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2012. 7. 18., 2017. 10. 18., 2019. 9. 17.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Future Power Business Division) ① The Head of the Future Power Business Division shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service or general officers; provided, however, that in the case of appointment as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Jul. 18, 2012; Oct. 18, 2017; Sep. 17, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ② 미래전력사업지원부장ㆍ우주지휘통신사업부장ㆍ유도무기사업부장ㆍ감시전자사업부장 및 첨단기술사업단장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 또는 장성급 장교로 보하되, 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <신설 2019. 9. 17., 2021. 11. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director of the Future Power Project Support Department, the Director of the Space Command and Communications Project Department, the Director of the Guided Weapons Project Department, the Director of the Surveillance and Electronic Warfare Project Department, and the Director of the Advanced Technology Project Group shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service or general officers; provided, however, that if appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of such position shall be Grade B. <Newly added Sep. 17, 2019; Nov. 23, 2021>
[Title amended Sep. 17, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제17조(미래전력사업지원부의 하부조직) ① 미래전력사업지원부에 미래전력사업총괄팀ㆍ국제확정전력운영계약팀ㆍ국제한도액전력운영계약팀ㆍ미래전력사업전력화지원관리팀ㆍ미래전력사업표준자원관리팀 및 미래전력사업원가팀을 둔다. <개정 2020. 7. 1., 2021. 7. 23., 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Subordinate Organizations of the Future Electricity Business Support Department) ① The Future Electricity Business Support Department shall be established with the Future Electricity Business General Team, the International Fixed-Rate Power Operation Contract Team, the International Limit Power Operation Contract Team, the Future Electricity Business Electrification Support Management Team, the Future Electricity Business Standard Resource Management Team, and the Future Electricity Business Cost Team. <Amended Jul. 1, 2020; Jul. 23, 2021; Mar. 26, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 미래전력사업총괄팀장 및 미래전력사업전력화지원관리팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로, 국제확정전력운영계약팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로, 국제한도액전력운영계약팀장ㆍ미래전력사업표준자원관리팀장 및 미래전력사업원가팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로 보한다. <개정 2019. 12. 31., 2020. 7. 1., 2021. 7. 23., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Future Power Business General Team and the Head of the Future Power Business Electrification Support Management Team shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or Field-grade officers; the Head of the International Fixed-Rate Power Operation Contract Team shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, or Field-grade officers; and the Heads of the International Limit Power Operation Contract Team, the Head of the Future Power Business Standard Resource Management Team, and the Head of the Future Power Business Cost Team shall be appointed as Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, or Field-grade officers. <Amended Dec. 31, 2019; July 1, 2020; July 23, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 미래전력사업총괄팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Future Power Business Management Team shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 미래전력사업본부 내 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of operations within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 2. 미래전력사업본부 내 방위력개선사업에 대한 중기계획 및 예산의 종합ㆍ요구
rows.text_en: 2. Comprehensive review and request for mid-term plans and budgets for defense capability improvement projects within the Future Power Business Headquarters

rows.source_ko: 3. 미래전력사업본부 내 방위력개선사업 추진계획의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and coordination of implementation plans for defense capability improvement projects within the Future Power Business Headquarters

rows.source_ko: 4. 미래전력사업본부 내 방위력개선사업의 관리와 관련된 법령 및 훈령ㆍ예규 등의 제ㆍ개정과 제도 발전에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the enactment and amendment of laws, directives, and established regulations related to the management of defense capability improvement projects within the Future Power Projects Headquarters, as well as institutional development

rows.source_ko: 5. 미래전력사업본부 소관 업무에 관한 국회 및 감사 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 5. Matters related to the National Assembly and audits concerning the business under the jurisdiction of the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 6. 미래전력사업본부 내 인사ㆍ교육에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Personnel and training matters within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 7. 미래전력사업본부 내 경상비 예산 운영 및 보급 관리 업무
rows.text_en: 7. Operation of operating budget and supply management within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 8. 미래전력사업본부 내 보안에 관한 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 8. Overall management of security matters within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 9. 미래전력사업본부 내 행정관리에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 9. Duties regarding administrative management within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 10. 미래전력사업본부 내 성과관리 및 홍보에 관한 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 10. Overall management of performance management and public relations within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 11. 미래전력사업본부 내 조달사업 집행 지시 및 예산 관리
rows.text_en: 11. Instructions for Procurement Project Execution and Budget Management within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 12. 미래전력사업본부 내 사업집행실적 분석ㆍ점검
rows.text_en: 12. Analysis and Review of Business Execution Performance within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 13. 미래전력사업본부 내 관인 및 문서 관리에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 13. Duties regarding official seal and document management within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 14. 미래전력사업본부 내 지출심사분야의 계획 수립 및 심사ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 14. Planning, Review, and Evaluation of Expenditure Review Fields within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 15. 미래전력사업본부 내 재무관 및 계약관 직인 관리
rows.text_en: 15. Management of official seals for the Finance Officer and Contract Officer within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 16. 미래전력사업본부 내 대금(선금ㆍ착수금 및 중도금을 포함한다) 청구서류의 접수ㆍ심사 및 지급의뢰
rows.text_en: 16. Receipt, examination, and payment request for invoices (including advance payments, down payments, and interim payments) within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 17. 미래전력사업본부 내 채권양도 승인 및 납품실적 증명에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 17. Tasks regarding approval of assignment of receivables and certification of delivery performance within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 18. 미래전력사업본부 내 월별 대금지출 소요의 종합
rows.text_en: 18. Summary of Monthly Payment Requirements within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 19. 그 밖에 미래전력사업본부내 다른 팀의 소관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 19. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other teams within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: ④ 국제확정전력운영계약팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the International Fixed Power Operation Contract Team shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「방위사업청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제15조제2호 및 제3호의 조달 품목(이하 이 조에서 “국외 조달 품목”이라 한다)의 국제부품ㆍ장비 계약 관련 기획ㆍ계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of planning and strategies regarding international parts and equipment contracts for procurement items under Article 15, Subparagraphs 2 and 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies” (hereinafter referred to as “overseas procurement items” in this Article).

rows.source_ko: 2. 국외 조달 품목의 국제부품ㆍ장비 계약 체결에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the conclusion of international parts and equipment contracts for items procured from overseas

rows.source_ko: 3. 국외 조달 품목의 국제부품ㆍ장비 계약에 따른 신용장 개설 및 계약이행보증금의 설정에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the opening of letters of credit and the establishment of performance guarantees pursuant to international contracts for parts and equipment procured from overseas

rows.source_ko: 4. 국외 조달 품목의 국제부품ㆍ장비 구매계약에 따른 대금지불 및 사후 관리에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning payment and post-purchase management pursuant to international parts and equipment purchase contracts for items procured from overseas

rows.source_ko: 5. 국외 조달 품목 계약에 따른 국외위조부품 관련 사후조치
rows.text_en: 5. Follow-up measures regarding foreign counterfeit parts pursuant to contracts for overseas procurement items

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 국제한도액전력운영계약팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Team Leader of the International Limit Power Operation Contracts Team shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「방위사업청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제15조제2호의 조달 품목의 국제 성과기반 군수지원계약에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning international performance-based logistics support contracts for procurement items under Article 15, Subparagraph 2 of the "Organizational Structure of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies"

rows.source_ko: 2. 「방위사업청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제15조제2호의 조달 품목의 국제 한도액계약(「방위사업법 시행령」 제61조제1항제5호에 따른 한도액계약을 말한다. 이하 같다) 관련 기획ㆍ계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of planning and strategies related to international ceiling contracts for procurement items under Article 15, Subparagraph 2 of the "Organizational Structure of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies" (referring to ceiling contracts pursuant to Article 61, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 5 of the "Enforcement Decree of the Defense Acquisition Program Act"; hereinafter the same applies).

rows.source_ko: 3. 「방위사업청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제15조제2호의 조달 품목의 국제 한도액계약 체결 및 관리와 그에 부수되는 업무
rows.text_en: 3. Conclusion and management of international ceiling contracts for procurement items under Article 15, Subparagraph 2 of the "Organizational Structure of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies," and incidental duties

rows.source_ko: 4. 「방위사업청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제15조제2호의 조달 품목의 국제장비 기술용역 계약에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning international equipment technical service contracts for procurement items under Article 15, Subparagraph 2 of the "Organizational Structure of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies"

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 미래전력사업전력화지원관리팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 7. 23., 2022. 12. 20.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Team Leader of the Future Power Business Electrification Support Management Team shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jul. 23, 2021; Dec. 20, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 미래전력사업본부 내 각 사업부의 통합체계지원(IPS) 업무 기술지원 및 업무체계의 발전
rows.text_en: 1. Technical support for Integrated System Support (IPS) operations and development of work systems for each business unit within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 2. 미래전력사업본부 내 통합체계지원에 대한 분석결과의 검토ㆍ검증 및 환류
rows.text_en: 2. Review, verification, and feedback of analysis results regarding integrated system support within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 3. 미래전력사업본부 내 통합체계지원 분석시스템의 운영 및 자료 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Operation and Data Management of the Integrated System Support Analysis System within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 5. 미래전력사업 관련 전력화 이후 현존전력 성능 극대화 사업, 획득ㆍ운영유지 연계사업 등 전력화 지원 업무
rows.text_en: 5. Electrification support tasks related to future power projects, such as projects to maximize the performance of existing power after electrification and projects linking acquisition, operation, and maintenance.

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 미래전력사업표준자원관리팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 7. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Team Leader of the Future Electric Power Business Standard Resource Management Team shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended July 23, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 미래전력사업본부 내 규격화 관련 계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of standardization-related plans within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 2. 미래전력사업본부 내 군수품 규격화 및 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Standardization and Management of Military Supplies within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 3. 미래전력사업본부 내 각 사업팀에서 사업 종료 후 형상자료를 인계한 운영단계 무기체계의 형상 관리에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 3. Tasks regarding configuration management of weapon systems in the operational phase, for which configuration data was handed over by each project team within the Future Power Business Division following project completion

rows.source_ko: 4. 미래전력사업본부 내 국외조달 요구 품목에 대한 국산화 개발 품목의 확인
rows.text_en: 4. Verification of domestically developed items for foreign procurement requirements within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 5. 미래전력사업본부 내 전력지원체계의 형상 관리에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 5. Duties regarding configuration management of the power support system within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 6. 미래전력사업본부 내 각 사업팀 등 다른 부서 소관 규격화 기술지원 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Standardization technical support tasks for other departments, such as business teams within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 7. 미래전력사업본부 내 국방규격의 관리ㆍ보급에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 7. Duties regarding the management and distribution of defense standards within the Future Power Business Headquarters

rows.text_en: 9. Review and technical support for cataloging tasks required for project execution by each business team within the Future Power Business Division

rows.text_en: 10. Support for catalog data required for performing procurement management tasks within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 11. 미래전력사업본부 내 군수품의 목록화 관련 도구관리 업무 지원
rows.text_en: 11. Support for tool management tasks related to the cataloging of military supplies within the Future Power Business Division

rows.source_ko: 12. 미래전력사업본부 내 외국과의 군수품목록정보 교류 실시

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 미래전력사업원가팀장은 미래전력사업본부 소관 방위력개선사업 및 국외 조달 품목에 관하여 다음 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Future Power Project Cost Team shall be responsible for the following matters regarding defense capability improvement projects and overseas procurement items under the jurisdiction of the Future Power Project Headquarters. <Amended Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.text_en: 2. Receipt and Analysis of Cost Statements

rows.source_ko: 제18조(우주지휘통신사업부의 하부조직) ① 우주지휘통신사업부에 우주지휘통신총괄계약팀ㆍ우주감시정찰사업팀ㆍ우주통신항법사업팀ㆍ우주기반체계사업팀ㆍ합동지상지휘통제체계사업팀ㆍ해상공중지휘통제체계사업팀 및 전술통제통신사업팀을 둔다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Subordinate Organizations of the Space Command and Communications Business Division) ① The Space Command and Communications Business Division shall be established with the Space Command and Communications General Contracting Team, the Space Surveillance and Reconnaissance Business Team, the Space Communications and Navigation Business Team, the Space Infrastructure Systems Business Team, the Joint Ground Command and Control System Business Team, the Maritime and Air Command and Control System Business Team, and the Tactical Control and Communications Business Team. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 우주지휘통신총괄계약팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로, 우주감시정찰사업팀장ㆍ우주통신항법사업팀장 및 전술통제통신사업팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로, 합동지상지휘통제체계사업팀장 및 해상공중지휘통제체계사업팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로, 우주기반체계사업팀장은 서기관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ통계사무관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ농업사무관ㆍ해양수산사무관ㆍ항공사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 영관급 장교로 보한다. <신설 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Space Command and Communications General Contracting Team shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or a field-grade officer; the Heads of the Space Surveillance and Reconnaissance Project Team, the Space Communications and Navigation Project Team, and the Tactical Control and Communications Project Team shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or a field-grade officer; the Heads of the Joint Ground Command and Control System Project Team and the Maritime-Air Command and Control System Project Team shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or a field-grade officer; and the Head of the Space Infrastructure System Project Team shall be appointed as a Secretary, Science and Technology Secretary, Administrative Officer, Statistics Officer, Industrial Officer, Agriculture Officer, Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Officer, Aviation Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or a field-grade officer. <Newly Inserted Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 우주지휘통신총괄계약팀장은 우주ㆍ지휘ㆍ통제ㆍ통신ㆍ정보 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제2항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 7. 23., 2021. 11. 23., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Space Command and Communications General Contracting Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 2, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the fields of space, command, control, communications, and information. <Amended July 23, 2021; November 23, 2021; December 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ 우주감시정찰사업팀장은 우주감시정찰 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 11. 23., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Space Surveillance and Reconnaissance Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of space surveillance and reconnaissance . <Amended Nov. 23, 2021; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 우주통신항법사업팀장은 우주통신항법 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 11. 23., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Space Communications and Navigation Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of space communications and navigation . <Amended Nov. 23, 2021; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 우주기반체계사업팀장은 우주기반체계(우주영역인식 및 우주전력투사를 위한 체계를 말한다) 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Space Infrastructure Systems Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3 , regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of space infrastructure systems (referring to systems for space domain recognition and space power projection) . <Newly added Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 합동지상지휘통제체계사업팀장은 합동지상지휘통제체계 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 11. 23., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Joint Ground Command and Control System Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of the Joint Ground Command and Control System. <Amended Nov. 23, 2021; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 해상공중지휘통제체계사업팀장은 해상공중지휘통제체계 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 11. 23., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Maritime-Air Command and Control System Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of the Maritime-Air Command and Control System. <Amended Nov. 23, 2021; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 전술통제통신사업팀장은 전술통제통신 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 11. 23., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Tactical Control and Communications Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of tactical control and communications. <Amended Nov. 23, 2021; Dec. 30, 2025>

[Wholly Amended Sep. 17, 2019]
[Title Amended Nov. 23, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제19조(유도무기사업부의 하부조직) ① 유도무기사업부에 유도무기총괄계약팀ㆍ지상유도무기사업팀ㆍ항공유도무기사업팀ㆍ다층방어유도무기사업팀ㆍ방공유도무기사업팀 및 해상유도무기사업팀을 두되, 유도무기총괄계약팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로, 지상유도무기사업팀장ㆍ항공유도무기사업팀장 및 다층방어유도무기사업팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로, 방공유도무기사업팀장 및 해상유도무기사업팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로 보한다. <개정 2019. 12. 31., 2021. 7. 23., 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Subordinate Organizations of the Guided Weapons Business Division) ① The Guided Weapons Business Division shall have the Guided Weapons General Contracting Team, Ground Guided Weapons Business Team, Air Guided Weapons Business Team, Multilayer Defense Guided Weapons Business Team, Air Defense Guided Weapons Business Team, and Maritime Guided Weapons Business Team; the Head of the Guided Weapons General Contracting Team shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Field-grade officer; the Heads of the Ground Guided Weapons Business Team, Air Guided Weapons Business Team, and Multilayer Defense Guided Weapons Business Team shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or Field-grade officer; and the Heads of the Air Defense Guided Weapons Business Team and Maritime Guided Weapons Business Team shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or Field-grade officer. <Amended Dec. 31, 2019; Jul. 23, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 12, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 유도무기총괄계약팀장은 방공ㆍ유도 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제2항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 7. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Guided Weapons General Contracting Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 2, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the air defense and guided weapon sectors . <Amended July 23, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ③ 지상유도무기사업팀장은 지상유도무기 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Ground Guided Weapons Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of ground guided weapons .

rows.source_ko: ④ 항공유도무기사업팀장은 항공유도무기 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2023. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Aerospace Guided Weapons Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of aerospace guided weapons . <Amended Dec. 12, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 다층방어유도무기사업팀장은 다층방어유도무기 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2023. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Team Leader of the Multilayer Defense Guided Weapons Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of multilayer defense guided weapons . <Amended Dec. 12, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 방공유도무기사업팀장은 방공유도무기 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2023. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Air Defense Guided Weapons Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of air defense guided weapons . <Amended Dec. 12, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 해상유도무기사업팀장은 해상유도무기 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2023. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Maritime Guided Weapons Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of maritime guided weapons . <Amended Dec. 12, 2023>
[Wholly revised Sep. 17, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제20조(감시전자사업부의 하부조직) ① 감시전자사업부에 감시전자총괄계약팀ㆍ전자전사업팀 및 레이더사업팀을 두되, 감시전자총괄계약팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로, 전자전사업팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로, 레이더사업팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로 보한다. <개정 2019. 12. 31., 2021. 7. 23., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Subordinate Organizations of the Surveillance Electronics Business Division) ① The Surveillance Electronics Business Division shall have the General Surveillance Electronics Contract Team, the Electronic Warfare Business Team, and the Radar Business Team; provided that the Head of the General Surveillance Electronics Contract Team shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or a Field-grade officer; the Head of the Electronic Warfare Business Team shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or a Field-grade officer; and the Head of the Radar Business Team shall be appointed as a Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or a Field-grade officer. <Amended Dec. 31, 2019; July 23, 2021; August 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 감시전자총괄계약팀장은 감시ㆍ정찰ㆍ전자 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제2항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 7. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the General Contracting Team for Surveillance and Electronic Services shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 2, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the fields of surveillance, reconnaissance, and electronic services . <Amended July 23, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ③ 전자전사업팀장은 전자전(戰) 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Electronic Warfare Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of electronic warfare .

rows.source_ko: ④ 레이더사업팀장은 레이더 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Radar Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the matters of each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3 regarding defense capability improvement projects in the radar field .
[Wholly revised Sep. 17, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제21조(첨단기술사업단의 하부조직) ① 첨단기술사업단에 첨단기술총괄계약팀ㆍ무인기사업팀ㆍ과학화체계사업팀 및 첨단항공엔진개발사업팀을 둔다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Subordinate Organizations of the Advanced Technology Business Group) ① The Advanced Technology Business Group shall have the Advanced Technology General Contracting Team, the Unmanned Aircraft Business Team, the Scientific System Business Team, and the Advanced Aerospace Engine Development Business Team. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 첨단기술총괄계약팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로, 무인기사업팀장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로, 과학화체계사업팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수석전문관 또는 영관급 장교로, 첨단항공엔진개발사업팀장은 서기관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ통계사무관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ농업사무관ㆍ해양수산사무관ㆍ항공사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 영관급 장교로 보한다. <신설 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Advanced Technology General Contracting Team shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or a field-grade officer; the Head of the Unmanned Aircraft Project Team as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or a field-grade officer; the Head of the Scientific System Project Team as a Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Senior Specialist, or a field-grade officer; and the Head of the Advanced Aviation Engine Development Project Team as a Secretary, Secretary for Science and Technology, Administrative Officer, Statistics Officer, Industrial Officer, Agriculture Officer, Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Officer, Aviation Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or a field-grade officer. <Newly Inserted Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 첨단기술총괄계약팀장은 무인항공ㆍ항공추진ㆍ지상무인ㆍ경계시스템 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제2항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 7. 23., 2021. 11. 23., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Advanced Technology General Contracting Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 2, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the fields of unmanned aerial vehicles, air propulsion, ground unmanned vehicles, and border security systems. <Amended July 23, 2021; November 23, 2021; December 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ 무인기사업팀장은 무인항공 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2020. 12. 31., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Unmanned Aircraft Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the unmanned aviation sector. <Amended Dec. 31, 2020; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 과학화체계사업팀장은 과학화 경계체계 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The head of the scientific system project team shall be responsible for the matters of each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3 regarding defense capability improvement projects in the field of scientific border security systems .

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 첨단항공엔진개발사업팀장은 항공추진 분야 방위력개선사업에 관하여 제13조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Advanced Aircraft Engine Development Project Team shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 3, regarding defense capability improvement projects in the aviation propulsion sector. <Newly added Dec. 30, 2025>

[Wholly Amended Sep. 17, 2019]
[Title Amended Nov. 23, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제22조(한시적인 보조기관의 설치) 「방위사업청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제17조제3항의 단서에 따른 한시적인 보조기관은 15개 팀의 범위(제15조에 따라 기반전력사업본부에 설치하는 한시적인 보조기관의 수를 포함한다)에서 방위사업청장이 정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Establishment of Temporary Auxiliary Agencies) Temporary auxiliary agencies pursuant to the proviso of Article 17, Paragraph 3 of the “Organization of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies” shall be determined by the Administrator of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration within the scope of 15 teams ( including the number of temporary auxiliary agencies established in the Base Force Project Headquarters pursuant to Article 15 ) .
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 31, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제4장의2 방위사업교육원 <신설 2020. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Chapter 4-2 Defense Acquisition Training Institute <Newly established Dec. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 제22조의2(방위사업교육원) ① 방위사업교육원장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 22-2 (Defense Acquisition Training Institute) ① The Director of the Defense Acquisition Training Institute shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 방위사업교육원(이하 이 조에서 “교육원”이라 한다)에 교육기획과 및 교육운영과를 두되, 교육기획과장 및 교육운영과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 영관급 장교로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: ② The Defense Acquisition Training Institute (hereinafter referred to as the “Training Institute”) shall establish an Education Planning Division and an Education Operations Division; provided that the heads of the Education Planning Division and the Education Operations Division shall be appointed from among Science and Technology Secretaries, Secretaries, or field-grade officers. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 12, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 교육기획과장은 다음 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Education Planning Division shall be responsible for the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 교육훈련계획의 수립 및 평가
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and Evaluation of Education and Training Plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 국내외 교육훈련 제도ㆍ기법의 연구 및 보급
rows.text_en: 2. Research and dissemination of domestic and international education and training systems and techniques

rows.source_ko: 3. 교육운영위원회 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Operation of the Education Steering Committee

rows.source_ko: 4. 교육원 내 인사관리
rows.text_en: 4. Human Resource Management within the Training Institute

rows.source_ko: 5. 교육원 내 예산 편성ㆍ집행 및 결산
rows.text_en: 5. Budget formulation, execution, and settlement within the Training Institute

rows.source_ko: 6. 교육원 내 보안 및 방호
rows.text_en: 6. Security and Protection within the Training Center

rows.source_ko: 7. 교육 홈페이지 및 교육원 내 정보화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the education website and informatization within the training center

rows.source_ko: 8. 방위사업 교육 홍보 및 국내외 관련 기관과의 협력
rows.text_en: 8. Defense industry education and promotion, and cooperation with relevant domestic and international organizations

rows.source_ko: 9. 그 밖에 교육원 내 다른 과의 소관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other departments within the Training Institute

rows.source_ko: ④ 교육운영과장은 다음 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of Education Operations shall be responsible for the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 방위사업 교육과정 운영
rows.text_en: 1. Operation of Defense Acquisition Training Curriculum

rows.source_ko: 2. 교육생 선발ㆍ등록 등 학적 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Student record management, including selection and registration of trainees

rows.source_ko: 3. 교육과정 개발 및 표준화
rows.text_en: 3. Curriculum Development and Standardization

rows.source_ko: 4. 교재개발 및 편찬
rows.text_en: 4. Development and compilation of textbooks

rows.source_ko: 5. 사례연구 및 강의
rows.text_en: 5. Case Studies and Lectures

rows.source_ko: 6. 방위사업 교육 관련 통계 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Management of statistics related to defense industry training

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 원장이 지정하는 교육과정 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Operation of other educational courses designated by the Director
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 31, 2020]

rows.source_ko: 제5장 공무원의 정원 등
rows.text_en: Chapter 5 Staffing Levels of Public Officials, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제23조(방위사업청에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 방위사업청에 두는 공무원(군인을 제외한다)의 정원(「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따른 한시정원은 제외한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)은 별표 1과 같다. 다만, 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조제2항 및 「방위사업청과 그 소속기관 직제」제21조제1항 단서에 따라 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원(군인을 제외한다)의 정원은 별표 1의2와 같으며, 별표 1의2의 정원 중 4명(5급 2명, 6급 1명, 7급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <개정 2017. 12. 29., 2018. 3. 30., 2020. 12. 31., 2022. 12. 20., 2023. 7. 14., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 7. 10., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Personnel Quota for Public Officials in the Defense Acquisition Program Administration) ① The personnel quota for public officials (excluding military personnel) in the Defense Acquisition Program Administration (excluding temporary personnel quotas pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quota of Administrative Agencies; hereinafter the same applies in this Article) is as set forth in Table 1. However, the personnel quota for public officials (excluding military personnel) determined separately within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total personnel quota pursuant to Article 29 , Paragraph 2 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quota of Administrative Agencies and the proviso to Article 21 , Paragraph 1 of the Organizational Structure of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration and its Affiliated Agencies shall be as set forth in Table 1-2 , and four of the personnel quota in Table 1-2 (two at Grade 5, one at Grade 6, and one at Grade 7) shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended Dec. 29, 2017; Mar. 30, 2018; Dec. 31, 2020; Dec. 20, 2022; Jul. 14, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024; Jul. 10, 2024; Dec. 30, 2025>

② Thirty of the authorized number of public officials in the Defense Acquisition Program Administration (2 at Grade 3 or 4, 2 at Grade 4, 2 at Grade 4 or 5, 6 at Grade 5, 8 at Grade 6, 9 at Grade 7, and 1 at Grade 8) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended Dec. 28, 2011; Dec. 12, 2013; Jan. 6, 2015; May 13, 2015; Dec. 31, 2015; Nov. 27, 2018; Dec. 20, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 방위사업청에 두는 공무원 정원 중 공공데이터 관련 업무를 담당하는 2명(5급 1명, 6급 1명) 및 디지털 홍보 관련 업무를 담당하는 1명(6급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <신설 2019. 3. 26., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ Among the authorized number of civil servants in the Defense Acquisition Program Administration, two persons responsible for public data-related duties (one at Grade 5 and one at Grade 6) and one person responsible for digital promotion-related duties (one at Grade 6) shall be appointed as fixed-term civil servants. <Newly added Mar. 26, 2019; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제24조(소속기관에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 기반전력사업본부에 두는 공무원(군인을 제외한다)의 정원(「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따른 한시정원은 제외한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)은 별표 2와 같다. 다만, 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조제2항 및 「방위사업청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제22조제1항 단서에 따라 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원(군인을 제외한다)의 정원은 별표 2의2와 같으며, 별표 2의2의 정원 중 1명(6급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <개정 2011. 12. 28., 2013. 12. 12., 2015. 5. 13., 2015. 12. 31., 2019. 9. 17., 2022. 12. 20., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 7. 10., 2025. 8. 1., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Personnel Quota for Public Officials in Affiliated Agencies) ① The personnel quota for public officials (excluding military personnel) in the Base Power Business Headquarters (excluding temporary personnel quotas pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies” ; hereinafter the same applies in this Article) isas set forth in Table 2. However, the personnel quota for public officials (excluding military personnel) determined separately within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total personnel quota pursuant to Article 29 , Paragraph 2 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies ” and the proviso to Article 22 , Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies”is as set forth in Table 2-2 , and one person (one person of Grade 6) among the personnel quota in Table 2-2 shall be appointed as a fixed-term public official. <Amended Dec. 28, 2011; Dec. 12, 2013; May 13, 2015; Dec. 31, 2015; Sep. 17, 2019; Dec. 20, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024; July 10, 2024; Aug. 1, 2025; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 기반전력사업본부에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 12명(5급 2명, 6급 2명, 7급 6명, 8급 2명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다. <개정 2024. 7. 10.>
rows.text_en: ② Of the authorized number of public officials in the Base Power Business Headquarters, 12 (2 at Grade 5, 2 at Grade 6, 6 at Grade 7, and 2 at Grade 8) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended July 10, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 미래전력사업본부에 두는 공무원(군인을 제외한다)의 정원은 별표 3과 같다. 다만, 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조제2항 및 「방위사업청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제22조제1항 단서에 따라 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원(군인을 제외한다)의 정원은 별표 3의2와 같으며, 별표 3의2의 정원 중 2명(7급 2명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <신설 2024. 7. 10., 2025. 8. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The authorized number of public officials (excluding military personnel) assigned to the Future Power Projects Headquarters is as set forth in Attached Table 3.
